ValidationRule.description: LCS Agent Name should be populated by Analytics when LCS is true. This rule ensure thats when LCS is true, LCS Agent Name cannot be set to blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( LCS__c, ISBLANK( LCS_Agent_Name__c ), ISCHANGED( LCS_Agent_Name__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: LCS Agent Name cannot be removed when LCS is checked.
